_about: Known outcome of every smoke case per tool, checked in CI by tools/check_smoke.py. ok: solved and accepted by the tier-1 oracle; rejected: solved, but to a different problem (a documented importer finding); failed: the tool raised (recorded failure); solved: no tier-1 verdict (CGMES fixture, graded against its published SV). Derived from the full sweep at 23e4a22. When a tool's behaviour changes on purpose (e.g. a fixed importer), update the entry.
